title: Shapley value of a subset indicator
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $A$ be a subset of an $n$-element set, and let $i$ be an element of that set. For the game that is $1$ exactly at coalition $A$ and $0$ at every other coalition, its Shapley value at $i$ is the sum of the probabilities of $A$ and $A\setminus\{i\}$ under the random-subset distribution if $i\in A$; if $i\notin A$, it is the negative of the sum of the probabilities of $A$ and $A\cup\{i\}$ under that distribution.
hypotheses_covered: $A$ is a subset of the $n$-element set
$i$ is an element of the $n$-element set
